messages:
devon: Heads up — PR #10121 is ready for final review. It touches orchestrator config, runtime router, and an infra scheduler tweak. Need runtime + infra + security sign-off to merge today for a canary roll.
alex: @devon can you drop the PR link and a one-paragraph risk summary?
devon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/10121\nQuick summary: - enable multi-queue routing (runtime/router/*)\n- infra/scheduler: change eviction header default (behind env var)\n- controlplane/auth: add header validation for new client headers\nRisk: rolling config change, gated by ENABLE_MULTI_QUEUE=false by default. Canary + feature flag recommended. Added metrics and extra logging.\nSnippet of rollout flag in config:\n```\nENABLE_MULTI_QUEUE=true  # staging only for canary\n``` 
sophia: I can take runtime/router. Can you paste the perf run numbers? specifically p95 and throughput deltas and any KV-cache impact?
devon: Staging perf run: p95 generation +3ms, throughput -2.5% at batch=512, KV-cache unchanged. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/10121/artifacts. We left the flag off by default; can enable per-cluster.
build-bot: CI: unit tests ✅ integration tests ✅ staging-deploy succeeded :rocket:
tara: I'll review the control plane auth changes. Need a short threat model: what headers are added, do they change token scopes, any migration path? If this must go to prod tonight I'd prefer at least a quick sec review before merge.
devon: Headers added: X-RW-Client and X-RW-Sig. Validation happens server-side; X-RW-Sig is HMAC over payload + timestamp. No token scope changes. Migration: config rollout only, default off. Plan in PR description. Target canary 22:00 UTC tonight.
alex: So approvals needed: @sophia for runtime, infra leads for eviction header, and @tara for security. @sophia you good to approve after perf check? @tara can you sign off on a canary-first rollout?
sophia: LGTM for runtime surface. One minor request: retry jitter should be 10-50ms instead of current 0-100ms to smooth bursts. Other than that approved. :white_check_mark:
tara: I can approve if you add a short note in the PR describing header validation and a unit test for X-RW-Sig verification. After that I'm fine with canary-first rollout.
devon: Will add the unit test and tighten jitter. Also pinging infra: @mike @sasha can you glance at the eviction header default change? It's behind the env var but changes scheduler behavior.
build-bot: CI: new push triggered, running tests... 
alex: If green and security test is present, we can merge during the 23:00 UTC merge window. @devon please tag me when green.
devon: Pushed fixes: added unit test, jitter 10-50ms, adjusted logging. CI shows green: https://ci.redwood-inference/10121/run/4321
build-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅
mike: Quick read from infra: eviction header default change OK as-is (env gated). No mass eviction expected. Approving from infra side. :thumbsup:
tara: Verified the unit test and header validation. Approved. :white_check_mark:
alex: All approvals in. Merge on green. Thanks everyone.
devon: Merged to main and started canary. I'll monitor logs and report back in #incidents if anything unexpected. Thanks all!
